documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Fonebox Retail Limited reported its best financial performance in terms of revenue and net profits for the financial year ended March 31, 2025. The company generated a total income of Rs. 34,273.26 Lakh and a net profit after tax of Rs. 454.61 Lakh. Management intends to strengthen operations through expenditure control and aggressive domestic marketing.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting a revenue of over 400 crore for FY25.
guidance.quote: Revenue target for this year FY. 25. Our revenue target is 400 plus at least.

guidance.claim: The company is projecting a revenue of around 700 crore for FY26.
guidance.quote: We are nearly projec(cid:415)ng revenue around 700 crores with the PAT of at least 8 crore rupees, this is what our target is.

demand_outlook.claim: The retail smartphone market in India is expected to grow by 8 to 10% annually until 2029.
demand_outlook.quote: And it is con(cid:415)nue being growing every year by 8 to 10% (cid:415)ll at least 2029.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that physical retail has been increasing over the last six quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: But since last 6 quarter, if we see the data physical retail is being increasing every day.

capex_expansion.claim: The company currently has 169 active stores and plans to open 14 more in Gujarat this year.
capex_expansion.quote: Presently Fonebox Retail Limited has 169 ac(cid:415)ve stores and 14 is in upcoming within this year in Gujarat

capex_expansion.claim: The company has 16 functional stores in Maharashtra with 9 upcoming.
capex_expansion.quote: and in Maharashtra 16 stores are already func(cid:415)oning and 9 are upcoming.

margins_costs.claim: The company aims to improve profitability by reducing expenditures and increasing marketing efforts.
margins_costs.quote: Your Company looks forward to strengthen its operations by curtailing expenditure, aggressive domestic marketing etc. This would further help the Company to improve its results and profitability.

margins_costs.claim: The company successfully negotiated improved margins with Samsung, Vivo, and Xiaomi.
margins_costs.quote: So I'm seeing on the some of the brands like Samsung, Vivo and Xiaomi. We are successful this year to increment our margin

margins_costs.claim: Finance costs decreased by 33% in H1 FY25 compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: We increased the 17% into a revenue expense management despite having the total expenses also grown equivalent to the revenue and the finance cost, as I have discussed already, that notable 33% reduc(cid:415)on is there into a finance cost

orders_capacity.claim: The company had 185 total active stores as of November 15, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The company decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25 to conserve resources.
capital_allocation.quote: With a view to conserve the resources for future prospect and growth of the Company, the Board of Directors of the Company have not recommended any dividend on equity shares for the financial year ended 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The company operates with a 70-30 split between FOCO and COCO store models.
capital_allocation.quote: The count should be 70-30 and the revenue should be 50-50.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that e-commerce companies are currently under profit pressure.
risks_headwinds.quote: Even if it is an Amazon or Flipkart, both are under a profit pressure. Right now.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces various risks including market conditions, regulatory changes, and competitive dynamics.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, market conditions in the retail distribution sector, economic and regulatory changes, competitive dynamics, the Company's ability to implement its strategies effectively, and fluctuations in customer demand.

management_commitments.claim: The company has appointed M/s. G K Kotecha & Associates as Secretarial Auditor for a five-year term.
management_commitments.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company, at its Meeting held on May, 21 2025, based on the recommendation of the Audit Committee, has, after considering and evaluating various proposals and factors such as independence, industry experience, technical skills, audit team, audit quality reports, etc. recommended the appointment of M/s. G K Kotecha & Associates, a peer reviewed firm of company secretaries in practice, to conduct Secretarial Audit and issue Secretarial Audit Report for a term of five (5) consecutive years from financial year April 1, 2025 up to March 31, 2030

management_commitments.claim: The company targets a revenue of 400 crore plus for the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Revenue target for this year FY. 25. Our revenue target is 400 plus at least.

management_commitments.claim: The company projects revenue of 700 crore and PAT of 8 crore for the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We are nearly projec(cid:415)ng revenue around 700 crores with the PAT of at least 8 crore rupees, this is what our target is.
